examples.en: The constant noise from the street began to irritate me.
examples.zh: 街上不斷的噪音開始讓我心煩。

examples.en: Wool sweaters sometimes irritate my skin in the winter.
examples.zh: 羊毛毛衣在冬天有時會刺激我的皮膚。

examples.en: Please don't irritate your little brother while he is studying.
examples.zh: 你弟弟在念書時，請不要惹他生氣。

examples.en: They spent their summer holiday on a quiet isle near the coast.
examples.zh: 他們在靠近海岸的一座寧靜小島上度過暑假。

examples.en: A small ferry takes visitors to the isle every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上都有一艘小渡輪載遊客前往那座小島。

examples.en: The tiny isle is home to only about fifty families.
examples.zh: 這座小島上只住了大約五十戶人家。

examples.en: Green ivy covered the old brick wall of our school.
examples.zh: 綠色的常春藤爬滿了我們學校的老磚牆。

examples.en: My grandmother grows ivy in a pot beside the window.
examples.zh: 我奶奶在窗邊的盆子裡種了常春藤。

examples.en: The ivy has climbed all the way up to the roof.
examples.zh: 常春藤已經一路爬到屋頂了。

examples.en: She wore a jade bracelet that her grandmother gave her.
examples.zh: 她戴著奶奶送她的玉手鐲。

examples.en: The museum has a famous jade carving from the Qing dynasty.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有一件著名的清朝玉雕。

examples.en: Many people believe that jade brings good luck and protects the wearer.
examples.zh: 許多人相信玉能帶來好運，並保佑配戴的人。

examples.en: The janitor unlocks the school gate at six every morning.
examples.zh: 工友每天早上六點開啟校門。

examples.en: Please ask the janitor to clean the spill in the hallway.
examples.zh: 請找工友來清理走廊上潑灑的東西。

examples.en: Our building's janitor fixed the broken light in the lobby.
examples.zh: 我們大樓的管理員修好了大廳壞掉的燈。

examples.en: The sweet smell of jasmine filled the garden in the evening.
examples.zh: 茉莉花的甜香在傍晚瀰漫整座花園。

examples.en: I ordered a cup of hot jasmine tea at the tea shop.
examples.zh: 我在茶店點了一杯熱茉莉花茶。

examples.en: She planted jasmine along the fence to make the yard smell nice.
examples.zh: 她沿著圍籬種了茉莉花，讓院子聞起來很香。

examples.en: We heard the jingle of keys as she opened the door.
examples.zh: 她開門時，我們聽到鑰匙的叮噹聲。

examples.en: That radio jingle has been stuck in my head all day.
examples.zh: 那首廣播廣告歌整天在我腦海裡揮之不去。

examples.en: The jingle of bells told us that the sleigh was coming.
examples.zh: 鈴鐺的叮噹聲告訴我們雪橇來了。

senses.zh: 使發出叮噹聲；叮噹作響

examples.en: The coins in his pocket jingle when he walks.
examples.zh: 他走路時，口袋裡的硬幣會叮噹作響。

examples.en: She likes to jingle her bracelets while she talks.
examples.zh: 她說話時喜歡讓手鐲叮噹作響。

examples.en: Bells on the door jingle whenever a customer comes in.
examples.zh: 每當有客人進來，門上的鈴鐺就會叮噹作響。

examples.en: The jockey leaned forward and urged his horse to run faster.
examples.zh: 騎師身體前傾，催促馬跑得更快。

examples.en: She trained for years to become a professional jockey.
examples.zh: 她多年來接受訓練，要成為專業騎師。

examples.en: The young jockey won his first race on Sunday afternoon.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的騎師在星期日下午贏得了他的第一場比賽。

examples.en: The whole family gathered for a joyous celebration at New Year.
examples.zh: 全家人在新年聚在一起歡慶。

examples.en: Children's laughter made the playground a joyous place.
examples.zh: 孩子們的笑聲讓遊樂場成了歡樂的地方。

examples.en: It was a joyous moment when the twins came home from the hospital.
examples.zh: 雙胞胎從醫院回到家的那一刻充滿喜悅。

examples.en: Turn left at the next junction and you will see the station.
examples.zh: 在下一個路口左轉，你就會看到車站。

examples.en: The two rivers meet at a junction just north of the town.
examples.zh: 兩條河在小鎮北邊的匯合處交會。

examples.en: There is a convenience store at the junction of Main Street and Park Road.
examples.zh: 在中央街與公園路的交叉口有一間便利商店。

examples.en: She has no close kin in this city, so she often feels lonely.
examples.zh: 她在這座城市沒有近親，所以常覺得孤單。

examples.en: Please notify the next of kin as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 請盡快通知最近親屬。

examples.en: Our kin from the countryside visit us every Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 我們鄉下的親戚每年農曆新年都會來拜訪我們。

examples.en: He used dry leaves to kindle a fire at the campsite.
examples.zh: 他用乾樹葉在營地生火。

examples.en: The teacher's story helped kindle my interest in history.
examples.zh: 老師的故事喚起了我對歷史的興趣。

examples.en: A kind word can kindle hope in a sad heart.
examples.zh: 一句溫暖的話可以在悲傷的心中燃起希望。

examples.en: The lad next door delivers newspapers before school every morning.
examples.zh: 隔壁的男孩每天早上上學前都會送報紙。

examples.en: He was just a young lad when he left his hometown.
examples.zh: 他離開家鄉時還只是個少年。

examples.en: The old man told the lads to stay away from the river.
examples.zh: 老先生叫那些小伙子別靠近河邊。

examples.en: They held a lavish wedding at a five-star hotel.
examples.zh: 他們在五星級飯店舉辦了一場奢華的婚禮。

examples.en: The host prepared a lavish dinner for all the guests.
examples.zh: 主人為所有賓客準備了豐盛的晚餐。

examples.en: She is lavish with her praise when students work hard.
examples.zh: 當學生努力用功時，她毫不吝嗇地稱讚他們。

examples.en: Grandparents often lavish gifts on their grandchildren.
examples.zh: 祖父母常常慷慨地送孫子孫女禮物。

examples.en: The critics lavish praise on the new movie.
examples.zh: 評論家對這部新電影讚不絕口。

examples.en: He likes to lavish money on expensive watches.
examples.zh: 他喜歡把錢大把花在昂貴的手錶上。

examples.en: The doctor explained the test results in terms a layman could understand.
examples.zh: 醫師用外行人也聽得懂的說法解釋檢查結果。

examples.en: To a layman, the contract looked simple, but it was not.
examples.zh: 對外行人來說，這份合約看起來很簡單，其實不然。

examples.en: This book is written for the layman, not for experts.
examples.zh: 這本書是為一般外行讀者而寫，不是給專家看的。

examples.en: The layout of our new apartment makes good use of space.
examples.zh: 我們新公寓的格局把空間運用得很好。

examples.en: I changed the layout of the poster to make it easier to read.
examples.zh: 我更改了海報的版面配置，讓它更容易閱讀。

examples.en: The website has a clean layout that is easy to follow.
examples.zh: 這個網站的版面簡潔，很容易看懂。

examples.en: We signed a one-year lease for the apartment near the MRT station.
examples.zh: 我們簽了一年的租約，租下靠近捷運站的公寓。

examples.en: The lease will end in June, so we need to find a new place.
examples.zh: 租約六月到期，所以我們得找新的住處。

examples.en: Please read the lease carefully before you sign it.
examples.zh: 簽字之前請仔細閱讀租約。

examples.en: The company decided to lease a small office downtown.
examples.zh: 公司決定在市中心租一間小辦公室。

examples.en: They lease their land to a local farmer.
examples.zh: 他們把土地租給當地的農夫。

examples.en: Many families prefer to lease a car instead of buying one.
examples.zh: 許多家庭寧可租車也不買車。

examples.en: The legislator visited our school to talk about the new education plan.
examples.zh: 那位立法委員來到我們學校，談論新的教育計畫。

examples.en: Each legislator has the right to vote on the new bill.
examples.zh: 每位立法委員都有權對新法案投票。

examples.en: Local residents sent letters to their legislator asking for a new park.
examples.zh: 當地居民寫信給他們的立法委員，請求興建一座新公園。

examples.en: The manager gave a lengthy speech that lasted over an hour.
examples.zh: 經理發表了一場長達一個多小時的冗長演說。

examples.en: Filling out the application form was a lengthy process.
examples.zh: 填寫申請表是個冗長的過程。

examples.en: After a lengthy discussion, the class chose a movie to watch.
examples.zh: 經過一番冗長的討論後，全班選了一部電影來看。

examples.en: The writer is a lesbian who has spoken openly about her family life.
examples.zh: 這位作家是女同性戀者，曾公開談論她的家庭生活。

examples.en: The survey asked lesbians about their experiences with health care.
examples.zh: 這項調查詢問女同性戀者接受醫療服務的經驗。

examples.en: The club welcomes lesbians as well as gay and straight people.
examples.zh: 這個社團歡迎女同性戀者，也歡迎男同性戀者和異性戀者。

examples.en: They went to a lesbian film festival last weekend.
examples.zh: 他們上週末去參加了一場女同志影展。

examples.en: The author wrote a lesbian love story set in the 1950s.
examples.zh: 作者寫了一個以一九五〇年代為背景的女同志愛情故事。

examples.en: She joined a lesbian support group at the community center.
examples.zh: 她加入了社區中心的一個女同志支持團體。

examples.en: Taking a short walk can lessen your stress after work.
examples.zh: 下班後散散步可以減輕壓力。

examples.en: Wearing a helmet will lessen the risk of head injury.
examples.zh: 戴安全帽可以降低頭部受傷的風險。

examples.en: The new bus line should lessen traffic near the school.
examples.zh: 新的公車路線應該能減少學校附近的車流。

examples.en: Some mushrooms in the forest are lethal if you eat them.
examples.zh: 森林裡有些蕈類吃了會致命。

examples.en: The label warns that the chemical can be lethal to children.
examples.zh: 標籤警告這種化學物質對孩童可能致命。

examples.en: A lethal dose of that medicine is very small.
examples.zh: 那種藥物的致死劑量非常小。

senses.zh: 負有法律責任的；容易遭遇不利情況的

examples.en: The company is liable for any damage caused by its products.
examples.zh: 公司要為其產品造成的任何損害負責。

examples.en: You are liable to slip if you run on the wet floor.
examples.zh: 你在濕滑的地板上跑步很容易滑倒。

examples.en: Tenants are liable for repairs if they break something in the apartment.
examples.zh: 房客如果弄壞公寓裡的東西，就有責任修理。

examples.en: The museum has an exhibit about the liberation of the city in 1945.
examples.zh: 博物館有一個關於一九四五年這座城市獲得解放的展覽。

examples.en: Moving out of her parents' house felt like a liberation to her.
examples.zh: 搬出父母的家對她來說像是一種解脫。

examples.en: The group worked for the liberation of the prisoners.
examples.zh: 這個團體致力於讓那些囚犯獲得釋放。

examples.en: The lieutenant led his team across the field during the drill.
examples.zh: 中尉在演習時帶領他的隊伍穿越場地。

examples.en: My uncle was a lieutenant in the navy for ten years.
examples.zh: 我叔叔曾在海軍擔任上尉十年。

examples.en: The captain asked his lieutenant to check the supplies.
examples.zh: 隊長請他的副手檢查補給品。

examples.en: Reading has been her lifelong hobby since she was a child.
examples.zh: 閱讀從她小時候起就是她一輩子的嗜好。

examples.en: They became lifelong friends after meeting in junior high school.
examples.zh: 他們在國中認識後，成了一輩子的朋友。

examples.en: Learning a new skill is a lifelong process.
examples.zh: 學習新技能是一個終身的過程。

examples.en: He had to limp home after twisting his ankle in the game.
examples.zh: 他在比賽中扭傷腳踝，只好一瘸一拐地走回家。

examples.en: The old dog began to limp after the long walk.
examples.zh: 那隻老狗走完長路後開始一跛一跛的。

examples.en: She tried not to limp as she walked into the classroom.
examples.zh: 她走進教室時努力不讓自己跛腳。

examples.en: The flowers went limp because nobody gave them water.
examples.zh: 花因為沒人澆水而萎靡了。

examples.en: His handshake was limp and he didn't look at me.
examples.zh: 他的握手軟綿綿的，也沒有看我。

examples.en: The lettuce is limp, so please buy a fresh one.
examples.zh: 這顆萵苣已經不脆了，請買一顆新鮮的。

examples.en: The huge liner left the harbor early in the morning.
examples.zh: 那艘巨大的客輪一大清早就離開了港口。

examples.en: Put a plastic liner in the trash can before you throw things in.
examples.zh: 把東西丟進垃圾桶之前，先放一個塑膠內襯袋。

examples.en: The coat has a warm liner that is easy to remove.
examples.zh: 這件外套有一層保暖的內襯，很容易拆下來。

examples.en: Some students linger in the hallway after the bell rings.
examples.zh: 有些學生在鐘響後還在走廊逗留。

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread lingered in the kitchen all morning.
examples.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味整個早上都留在廚房裡。

examples.en: Don't linger at the store, or we'll miss the last bus.
examples.zh: 別在店裡逗留，否則我們會錯過末班公車。

examples.en: This jacket has a thick lining that keeps you warm in winter.
examples.zh: 這件夾克有厚厚的襯裡，冬天能保暖。

examples.en: The lining of my coat is torn near the pocket.
examples.zh: 我外套的襯裡在口袋附近破了。

examples.en: The box has a soft lining to protect the glasses.
examples.zh: 這個盒子有柔軟的內襯來保護眼鏡。

examples.en: The government started a program to improve adult literacy.
examples.zh: 政府推出一項計畫來提升成年人的識字能力。

examples.en: Computer literacy is an important skill in the modern workplace.
examples.zh: 電腦素養是現代職場上的重要技能。

examples.en: Teachers work hard to build children's literacy in the first grade.
examples.zh: 老師們努力在一年級培養孩子的讀寫能力。

examples.en: The literal meaning of the word is different from how people use it.
examples.zh: 這個字的字面意思和人們使用它的方式不同。

examples.en: A literal translation of the sentence sounds strange in Chinese.
examples.zh: 這個句子的逐字翻譯在中文聽起來很奇怪。

examples.en: Don't take his joke in a literal way; he was just kidding.
examples.zh: 別把他的玩笑話照字面意思理解，他只是在開玩笑。

senses.zh: 有讀寫能力的；具備相關知識的

examples.en: Almost every adult in the country is literate now.
examples.zh: 現在這個國家幾乎每位成年人都識字。

examples.en: Most students in this class are computer literate.
examples.zh: 這個班上大部分學生都懂得使用電腦。

examples.en: A literate person can read signs and fill out forms easily.
examples.zh: 識字的人可以輕鬆看懂標示和填寫表格。

examples.en: The farmer raises livestock such as cows, pigs, and sheep.
examples.zh: 這位農夫飼養牛、豬、羊等家畜。

examples.en: Heavy rain forced the villagers to move their livestock to higher ground.
examples.zh: 大雨迫使村民把牲畜移到地勢較高的地方。

examples.en: The farmer checks that the livestock have clean water every day.
examples.zh: 農夫每天都會確認家畜有乾淨的水可喝。

examples.en: A small lizard ran across the wall and disappeared behind the picture.
examples.zh: 一隻小蜥蜴爬過牆壁，消失在畫框後面。

examples.en: The lizard lay on a warm rock to enjoy the sun.
examples.zh: 那隻蜥蜴趴在溫暖的岩石上曬太陽。

examples.en: My brother keeps a pet lizard in a glass tank.
examples.zh: 我弟弟在玻璃缸裡養了一隻寵物蜥蜴。

examples.en: We stayed in a wooden lodge at the foot of the mountain.
examples.zh: 我們住在山腳下的一間木造山莊。

examples.en: The ski lodge has a warm fireplace and a small café.
examples.zh: 這間滑雪小屋有溫暖的壁爐和一家小咖啡館。

examples.en: A hunting lodge once stood on this hill many years ago.
examples.zh: 許多年前，這座山丘上曾有一間狩獵小屋。

examples.en: The students will lodge with local families during their visit.
examples.zh: 學生們拜訪期間將借住在當地家庭。

examples.en: Customers can lodge a complaint at the front desk.
examples.zh: 顧客可以到櫃檯提出申訴。

examples.en: A small bone lodged in his throat while he was eating fish.
examples.zh: 他吃魚時，一根小骨頭卡在喉嚨裡。

examples.en: She set a lofty goal of becoming a doctor one day.
examples.zh: 她立下了將來成為醫師的遠大目標。

examples.en: The lofty mountains were covered with snow all year.
examples.zh: 高聳的群山一年到頭都被白雪覆蓋。

examples.en: He spoke in a lofty way that made his classmates feel small.
examples.zh: 他說話的口氣很高傲，讓同學覺得自己很渺小。

examples.en: The company changed its logo to make it look more modern.
examples.zh: 公司更換了標誌，讓它看起來更現代。

examples.en: Our class designed a logo for the school festival.
examples.zh: 我們班為校慶設計了一個標誌。

examples.en: You can find the logo on the front of the T-shirt.
examples.zh: 你可以在這件 T 恤的正面看到那個標誌。

examples.en: He felt lonesome after his best friend moved to another city.
examples.zh: 好朋友搬到別的城市後，他覺得很孤單。

examples.en: The lonesome road led through miles of empty farmland.
examples.zh: 那條偏僻的道路穿過綿延數英里的空曠農地。

examples.en: The old man lives a lonesome life in a small mountain village.
examples.zh: 那位老先生在山上的小村莊過著孤單的生活。

examples.en: Eating well and exercising can help increase your longevity.
examples.zh: 飲食均衡和運動有助於延長壽命。

examples.en: The island is famous for the longevity of its residents.
examples.zh: 這座島以居民長壽而聞名。

examples.en: The longevity of this phone's battery impressed many customers.
examples.zh: 這支手機電池的使用壽命之長，讓許多顧客印象深刻。

examples.en: Longitude lines run from the North Pole to the South Pole.
examples.zh: 經線從北極延伸到南極。

examples.en: Our teacher showed us how to find the longitude of Taipei on the map.
examples.zh: 老師示範如何在地圖上找出台北的經度。

examples.en: Sailors need both latitude and longitude to find their position.
examples.zh: 水手需要緯度和經度才能找出自己的位置。

examples.en: He bought a lottery ticket on his way home from work.
examples.zh: 他下班回家的路上買了一張彩券。

examples.en: The school uses a lottery to decide who gets a place in the club.
examples.zh: 學校用抽籤決定誰能進入社團。

examples.en: Winning the lottery would change her life completely.
examples.zh: 中樂透會徹底改變她的生活。

examples.en: Pink lotus flowers bloomed above the pond's surface during the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天，粉紅色的蓮花在池塘水面上方綻放。

examples.en: The lotus is an important symbol in many Asian cultures.
examples.zh: 蓮花在許多亞洲文化中是重要的象徵。

examples.en: We took photos of the lotus at the park yesterday.
examples.zh: 我們昨天在公園拍了蓮花的照片。

examples.en: Selling handmade soap online turned out to be a lucrative business.
examples.zh: 在網路上賣手工皂結果是個很賺錢的生意。

examples.en: She was offered a lucrative job at a famous company.
examples.zh: 她得到一份著名公司提供的高薪工作。

examples.en: The farmer found that growing tea was more lucrative than growing rice.
examples.zh: 那位農夫發現種茶比種稻更賺錢。

examples.en: Stores use big sales to lure customers inside.
examples.zh: 商店用大特價吸引顧客上門。

examples.en: The smell of fresh cookies lured the children into the kitchen.
examples.zh: 新鮮餅乾的香味把孩子們引進了廚房。

examples.en: Fishermen use small lights to lure fish to the surface.
examples.zh: 漁夫用小燈把魚引誘到水面。

examples.en: The lure of the big city attracts many young people.
examples.zh: 大城市的吸引力吸引了許多年輕人。

examples.en: The fisherman tied a bright lure to the end of his line.
examples.zh: 漁夫在釣線末端綁了一個亮晶晶的誘餌。

examples.en: The lure of easy money made him ignore the risks.
examples.zh: 輕鬆賺錢的誘惑讓他忽略了風險。

examples.en: The hills were lush and green after the spring rain.
examples.zh: 春雨過後，山丘一片翠綠茂盛。

examples.en: They walked through a lush forest on their way to the waterfall.
examples.zh: 他們穿過一片蔥鬱的森林，前往瀑布。

examples.en: The hotel has a lush garden with a swimming pool.
examples.zh: 這間飯店有一座綠意盎然的花園，還附游泳池。

examples.en: You can use a glass to magnify the small print on the label.
examples.zh: 你可以用放大鏡把標籤上的小字放大。

examples.en: The microscope can magnify the cells to a hundred times their size.
examples.zh: 顯微鏡可以把細胞放大到一百倍的大小。

examples.en: Social media can magnify a small problem into a big one.
examples.zh: 社群媒體可能把小問題放大成大問題。

examples.en: The old story is about a maiden who lived in a tower.
examples.zh: 這個古老的故事是關於一位住在塔裡的少女。

examples.en: The village maiden carried water from the well every morning.
examples.zh: 那位村中少女每天早上都從井邊提水。

examples.en: In the legend, a brave knight saved the maiden from danger.
examples.zh: 在傳說中，一位勇敢的騎士把少女從危險中救出來。

examples.en: The new ship will make its maiden voyage next week.
examples.zh: 這艘新船下週將進行首航。

examples.en: The senator gave her maiden speech to the committee on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 那位參議員星期二向委員會發表了她的首次演說。

examples.en: Her maiden name is Lin, but now she uses her husband's name.
examples.zh: 她婚前姓林，但現在用丈夫的姓。

examples.en: The majestic mountain looked beautiful at sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出時，那座雄偉的山顯得非常美麗。

examples.en: We visited a majestic old temple during our trip to Kyoto.
examples.zh: 我們去京都旅行時參觀了一座壯麗的古寺。

examples.en: The eagle spread its majestic wings and flew over the valley.
examples.zh: 老鷹展開雄偉的翅膀，飛越山谷。

examples.en: Tourists were amazed by the majesty of the mountains.
examples.zh: 遊客們對群山的雄偉感到驚嘆。

examples.en: The guide described the majesty of the old royal palace.
examples.zh: 導遊描述了這座古老皇宮的壯麗。

examples.en: In the play, the servant bowed and said, "Yes, Your Majesty."
examples.zh: 在劇中，僕人鞠躬說：「是的，陛下。」
